jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The People Science team, within Grab's Office of Organisational Capabilities, turns people data, research, and AI into better organisational decisions. We are building a user-centric intelligence capability that helps Grabbers, managers, People teams, and business leaders understand what is happening, identify what matters, and take effective action. Get to Know the Role As Data Scientist, People Analytics you will apply strategic consulting, applied research, and structured problem-solving to complex people and organisational challenges. You will build AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, develop an organisational listening engine that turns signals into action, and advise People and business leaders on real problems. This is a hands-on role requiring research rigour, analytical judgement, and user-centric product thinking. You will report to the Head, People Science. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Build an organisational listening and action engine using employee listening, workforce, behavioural, and operational data to identify signals, diagnose root causes, and guide action. Build user-centric AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, from data discovery and analysis to hypothesis testing, programme evaluation, insight generation, and recommendations. Conduct applied organisational research using qualitative and quantitative methods, including surveys, interviews, experiments, and mixed-method approaches. Design hypotheses and evaluate People programmes or interventions using appropriate research, experimental, or quasi-experimental methods. Act as a strategic advisor to People and business leaders by framing ambiguous problems, conducting analysis, evaluating options, and translating evidence into practical decisions. Democratise people data through accessible AI agents, self-service tools, and data products that help non-technical users make better decisions. What Essential Skills You Will Need 8 - 12 years of experience in strategic consulting, applied research, organisational research, decision science, analytics, or a related field, with hands-on end-to-end problem solving. Experience advising senior stakeholders by defining ambiguous problems, diagnosing root causes, evaluating options, and translating evidence into practical decisions. Strong applied research capability across qualitative and quantitative methods, including research design, hypothesis development, surveys, interviews, experiments, and mixed-method approaches. Practical knowledge of programme evaluation, experimental design, causal or quasi-experimental analysis, and the ability to interpret evidence and its limitations. Experience synthesise data, research findings, and user perspectives into clear recommendations. Working proficiency in at least one analytical language, such as SQL, Python, or R, with the ability to conduct and interpret analysis. Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to improve research, analysis, workflows, and decision support, with an understanding of responsible AI, privacy, and bias considerations. Good To Have Experience in People Analytics, organisational psychology, behavioural science, workforce strategy, or social research. Experience building or prototyping AI systems, AI agents, LLM-enabled workflows, or analytical automation. Experience with employee listening, behavioural interventions, productivity measurement, programme implementation, or organisational change. jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team Join our Demand and Personalization Data Science team, where machine learning, economics, and large-scale engineering intersect. We build the core ranking, recommendation, and algorithmic incentive systems that determine what millions of users see and which merchant offers they receive across Southeast Asia. Our work directly drives discovery, engagement, and platform marketplace efficiency at scale, operating within high-throughput, low-latency production environments. Get to Know the Role We are looking for a Data Scientist to develop, deploy, and operate production-grade ranking and recommendation models. Reporting to the Data Science Manager II, this is a full-time 24 months contract role based onsite at the Grab One-North Singapore office. You'll collaborate with senior data scientists, product managers, and software engineers to own models end-to-end—from feature engineering and offline experimentation to live deployment and monitoring. If you're passionate about solving high-stakes marketplace algorithms at consumer scale, we invite you to apply. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Design, optimize, and maintain training-data and feature extraction pipelines across regional markets, ensuring data integrity and system reliability (including participating in team on-call rotations). Formulate, engineer, and validate new user and merchant personalization signals to measurably improve discovery relevance, CTR, and conversion. Formulate testable algorithmic hypotheses, run online A/B experiments, and monitor long-term holdout groups to rigorously measure business and user impact. Collaborate with Engineering to design, deploy, and scale real-time recommendation services and automated incentive allocation systems under strict SLA and latency budgets. Manage production ML operations, including automated retraining pipelines, feature backfills, telemetry, and proactive drift monitoring. Leverage Generative AI (GenAI) coding tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate model prototyping, automate repetitive data scripts, and drive team innovation. What Essential Skills You Will Need At least 1 year of hands-on industry experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer focusing on ranking, recommendation systems, or search (or an advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field with relevant production internship experience). Demonstrated experience with learning-to-rank algorithms, CTR/CVR prediction, relevance modelling, or two-tower retrieval architectures (e.g., GBDT, deep ranking models). Experience with offline ranking evaluation metrics (e.g., NDCG, MRR, AUC, MAP) alongside practical experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting online A/B tests. Programming proficiency in Python and SQL, with at least 1 year of practical experience building and debugging production pipelines using Apache Spark and Airflow. Practical understanding of deploying ML models into real-world production environments, handling latency tradeoffs, and monitoring pipeline health. Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas. We sit inside the decisions, not downstream of them. You'll learn from senior analysts who have done this across Grab, and you'll get ownership early. Most analytics roles hand you a dashboard queue, or ask you to build pipelines. We instead will hand you questions about how millions of people borrow, pay and save. Grab Financial Services runs payments, lending, insurance and the digital banks as one team. We serve people across Southeast Asia that traditional banks often overlook. Your work will shape products they use every day. You'll also learn analytics the way it's done now, in an AI-first world. Our analysts work with AI agents every day. Agents take the first pass at queries and analysis. You'll learn to direct them, check them and build with them. Few teams anywhere work this way yet! You will provide expertise and produce data-driven hypotheses to solve important Product and Business problems, and guide our Financial Services' strategies forward. You will report into the Senior Analytics Manager, Payments of Lending and work onsite at our office in Singapore, Grab HQ One-North. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Deliver reliable analysis: Take clearly defined problems and deliver accurate answers. Learn the experimentation craft: Help design, run and read A/B tests with support from senior analysts. Build your judgement on how to interpret experiment results. Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, metric definitions and the data your partners rely on. Accuracy is non-negotiable. Work AI-first: Use AI tools every day to write SQL and Python, explore data and speed up your work. Check what they give you before anyone else sees it. Automate the repetitive parts of your job. Keep partners in the loop: Share progress, changes and findings early. Explain what the data says in plain language and with enough context to act on. Manage your growth: Ask for feedback, act on it and pick up our best practices quickly. What Essential Skills You Will Need 0 to 3 years in analytics, data science or a related role. Internships or research projects count. A degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. Solid SQL and working Python. A good grasp of statistics and hypothesis testing. Hands-on A/B testing experience will be an advantage. You already work with AI. You use AI tools in your daily work and can show us something you built or automated with them. A side project counts! Communication - you can explain an analysis to someone who isn't a data person. Curiosity and a fast learning curve. You ask good questions and don't stay stuck for long. Nice to have: an interest in FinTech, lending or banking. 1+ years of experience with a visualisation tool. About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

Driving Product Innovation with Advanced Computer Vision Technology

HeyGen is a dynamic startup at the forefront of revolutionizing video content with state-of-the-art artificial intelligence technology. With a robust track record of growth and a proven business model, we are rapidly carving out a leadership position in the AI-powered video creation industry. We are in search of passionate Research Scientists with a specialization in Computer Vision to propel our mission forward. If you are eager to deploy your advanced skills to disrupt and redefine the video creation and interaction experience, your next big opportunity awaits with us.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Applied Innovation and Product Development: Harness your knowledge of generative models, including GANs, Diffusion models, and other multi-modal models, to propel our video creation tools forward. Your role involves translating state-of-the-art research into innovative features that directly enhance our user experience and set our products apart.

  • Real-World Solutions: Channel your research capabilities to develop scalable solutions that have a significant impact on our platform, making the video creation process more intuitive, powerful, and accessible to our users.

  • Collaborative Engineering and Growth: Engage with a diverse team where collaborative efforts lead to extraordinary outcomes. Embrace an environment that promotes learning, mentorship, and teamwork, furthering both personal development and the advancement of our technology.

Qualifications:

  • A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 1-3 years of experience in machine learning and computer vision, demonstrating practical application of generative models and a passion for product-centric innovation.
  • Proficiency in Python, with openness to other programming languages and tools as required by project demands.
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, and a capacity for quickly mastering new technologies.
  • A collaborative spirit with a proven track record in a team-based research or development setting.
  • A lifelong learner with outstanding problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively in a diverse team environment.

What HeyGen Offers:

  • Competitive Salary and Benefits: We offer a salary commensurate with your experience and a comprehensive benefits package that addresses a variety of needs.
  • Innovative and Inclusive Work Environment: Our workplace is designed to inspire innovation through collaboration, respect, and mutual support.
  • Opportunities for Advancement: We are committed to your professional development, offering extensive opportunities for learning, mentorship, and career growth.
  • Dedication to Diversity: HeyGen is an equal opportunity employer, championing a diverse and inclusive team that ensures equal access to opportunities for all members.

jobs.description_text:
About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

Position Summary

HeyGen is building AI applications including Avatar IV, Photo Avatar, Interactive Avatar, and Video Translation. We’re looking for a Software Engineer focused on GPU performance to make the systems behind these experiences faster and more efficient.

You will work across model execution and inference infrastructure, using profiling and measurement to improve latency, throughput, and GPU cost. This role is a fit for an engineer who enjoys understanding how software uses the hardware beneath it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Use NVIDIA Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and PyTorch Profiler to investigate GPU utilization, kernel execution, memory bandwidth, and CPU–GPU data movement.
  • Identify bottlenecks across model execution, preprocessing, and inference serving, then measure the impact of each optimization.
  • Improve performance through batching, scheduling, memory management, and better GPU utilization.
  • Develop or integrate high-performance GPU kernels when existing implementations limit performance.
  • Build benchmarks and automated checks that catch performance regressions across representative video workloads.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers and infrastructure engineers to bring optimizations into production.
  • Measure the effect of changes on latency, throughput, cost, and output quality.

Qualifications

  • Experience optimizing GPU-based AI workloads or high-performance computing systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with PyTorch or a similar machine learning framework.
  • Strong curiosity about GPU hardware, including memory bandwidth, cache behavior, tensor cores, and data movement between CPU and GPU.
  • Experience using profiling tools to connect hardware behavior to application-level bottlenecks and validate improvements.
  • Ability to turn performance experiments into reliable production changes and communicate tradeoffs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CUDA, Triton, or C++ GPU programming.
  • Experience optimizing video, image, audio, diffusion, or Transformer models.
  • Familiarity with multi-GPU inference, GPU interconnects, quantization, or large-scale model serving.
  • Experience building performance benchmarks or regression testing infrastructure.
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced technology environment.

What HeyGen Offers

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
  • Collaborative culture that values innovation and creativity.
  • Access to the latest technologies and tools.

HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join us at HeyGen

Help us make AI video faster and more accessible. We’d love to hear from you.

This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale. Responsibilities: Decompose end-to-end processes: Map current-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation. Architect the agentic solution: Build future-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human-in-the-loop controls. Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's “Secure by Design” and data-classification standards. Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery. Engineer trust and control: Define testable human-in-the-loop controls and least-privilege permissions for each process step. Drive multi-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
